We Buy iPads ads

“We Buy iPads” ads and flyers

BUYBACK.AD makes buyback ads for resellers and repair shops who buy used and cracked iPads. Pick a design, type your phone number and area, and download an image ready for Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist, Instagram or a printed flyer.

See the iPads designs Pricing

How it works

  1. Pick a design. Open the iPads designs and click one. It opens in the studio with its colours, product picture and copy already in place.
  2. Type your details. Your phone number, website if you have one, and your ZIP or city. Save them once in your brand kit and every design fills them in.
  3. Download and post. Choose a size (square for feeds, 9:16 for stories, 8.5×11 for print) and download. Every iPad design is on the free plan.

What to put on an iPad buyback ad

  • Which iPads you take: iPad, iPad mini, iPad Air, iPad Pro.
  • Whether you take cracked screens, and Wi-Fi or cellular models.
  • What the seller should send you: model, size and storage.
  • How you pay, your phone number and your area.

Keep it to one headline, a few short selling points and one number. People scroll past an ad in a second; the ones that get texts are readable at a glance on a phone.

Questions

Are the iPad templates free?

Yes. The iPad designs are in the Phones & Devices category, and every design there is on the free plan.

Can I add my own photo of an iPad?

Yes. Upload a photo as the background (iPhone HEIC photos work), then blur or tint it so the text stays readable.

Is it free?

You can design without an account. Downloading needs a free account: 3 photo downloads a week at 1080 pixels with a BUYBACK.AD watermark. Starter is $25 a month for 100 photo downloads up to 2160 pixels, no watermark, every design. Pro ($60) adds video ads and 500 downloads a month; Business ($100) is unlimited.
